_comment: Extended manifest read by emit-collection.ps1 and audit-collection.ps1. A SUPERSET of api-audit/api-manifest.example.json: module_name and endpoints[].{path,method} are what audit-ords-drift.sql reads, and every other field here is optional and ignored by it (C2). One manifest, two consumers -- do not fork it.
collection_description: Employee portal API. SOURCE: API MANIFEST, NOT VERIFIED AGAINST A DEPLOYED MODULE.

auth._comment: loginEndpoint lets the collection ship a login request that stores the token into the collection variable, so nobody has a reason to paste a literal (C4).

variables.description: Host and port only; base_path is appended per request.
Bearer token. Populated by Auth / Login's test script -- never committed with a value.

endpoints.name: Login
endpoints.summary: Exchange credentials for a session token.

responses.description: Invalid credentials. Does not disclose which field was wrong.

endpoints.name: List my requests
endpoints.summary: Leave requests raised by the authenticated employee, newest first.

queryParams.name: fetch_size
queryParams.description: ORDS page size (A7). :page_size is deprecated AND reserved.

endpoints.name: Create request
endpoints.summary: Raise a leave request for the authenticated employee. Balance, overlap and eligibility are re-checked server-side.

requestBody._comment: employee_id is NOT in the body -- it is resolved from the token server-side (A9).

responses.description: Created. Location header carries the new resource.
Validation failed -- overlap, insufficient balance, or ineligible leave type.

endpoints.name: Approve request
endpoints.summary: Approve a subordinate's leave request. Caller must be the frozen approver on the request.

responses.description: Caller is not the approver on this request.
object_version_number did not match -- concurrent edit.

endpoints.name: List lookups
endpoints.summary: All lookup values for the application, fetched once and cached client-side.

queryParams.name: p_lookup_type
queryParams.description: Single lookup type. Omit for the full cross-type cache.

responses.description: LEGACY ENVELOPE: HTTP is always 200. The real outcome is response_code.

endpoints.name: Get asset
endpoints.summary: One asset record with its current assignment.

responses.description: No such asset, or the caller lacks the IT persona.

endpoints._comment: Deliberately has no 200 example: emit-collection.ps1 renders NO EXAMPLE CAPTURED for the success case rather than inventing a body (C3).
